programme.title: Informatikk: programmering og systemarkitektur (bachelor)
programme.campus: Blindern, Oslo (Department of Informatics, Ole-Johan Dahls hus, Gaustadalléen 23B)
programme.how_found: Direct URL on uio.no/studier/program; teaching language from UiO English admission page ('All our other bachelor's programmes are taught in Norwegian'); campus from Department of Informatics contact page (mn.uio.no/ifi/om/organisasjon/adm/) - programme page itself does not name a campus.
programme.quote: UiO currently has one bachelor's programme taught in English . All our other bachelor’s programmes are taught in Norwegian, and to apply for these you must document that you are already proficient in Norwegian.

value.description: Norwegian-taught programme: applicants must document Norwegian proficiency plus meet the English requirement of Generell studiekompetanse. Exact Norwegian/English test levels are defined by Samordna opptak/HK-dir (samordnaopptak.no, hkdir.no), not published on uio.no.

english.quote: In order to be qualified for admission to study programmes taught in Norwegian, applicants must meet the requirements for Higher Education Entrance Qualification (generell studiekompetanse) (hkdir.no), including Norwegian and English language requirements (samordnaopptak.no).
english.how_found: uio.no English admission pages -> residing-applicants -> residing-gsk
english.notes: NORWEGIAN REQUIRED. Second confirmation on https://www.uio.no/english/studies/admission/: 'to apply for these you must document that you are already proficient in Norwegian' and UiO offers no preparatory Norwegian courses. Specific test scores (e.g. Norwegian B2 / IELTS) live on samordnaopptak.no, a non-university domain, so not recorded as values. UiO does accept IELTS Academic/TOEFL iBT/Cambridge/PTE as formats (same page).

value.description: No minimum grade average; qualified applicants ranked by Samordna opptak points. Lowest points that received an offer in 2026, ordinary quota (ordinær kvote); first-time diploma quota: all qualified applicants got an offer. Special requirement: Matematikk R1 (or S1+S2) equivalent. Applicants whose grades cannot be converted to points are ranked by discretionary assessment.

gpa.quote: Kvalifiserte søkere rangeres etter poeng . Kvalifiserte søkere som ikke kan poengberegnes, blir rangert i forhold til poengberegnede søkere ved hjelp av en skjønnsmessig vurdering, jf. § 7-12 i forskrift om opptak til høgare utdanning . Poenggrenser i 2026
gpa.notes: Same page: 'Poenggrenser i 2026 Kvote for førstegangsvitnemål: alle kvalifiserte fikk tilbud. Ordinær kvote: 35,2'. Cutoff is last year's, not a threshold for 2027. Whether a Kazakhstan NIS grade 12 diploma meets generell studiekompetanse is defined on hkdir.no (not checked, non-university domain).

deadline.quote: Applicants from non-EU countries who need a residence permit in order to study in Norway may apply for early admission (NUCAS - in Norwegian only). The NUCAS application deadline for early admission is 1 March .
deadline.how_found: uio.no English admission -> residing-applicants page; programme page also says 'Søknadsfrist: 15. april ( 1. mars for noen søkergrupper)'
deadline.notes: Only the 2026 cycle is published (page says ordinary deadline '15 April (2026)'); 1 March is a recurring date, so 2027-03-01 is expected for August 2027 but not yet published. All basic requirements must be met by 1 March. Applications via Samordna opptak; admission once a year.

tuition.how_found: Programme opptak page -> Studieavgift link -> 'Tabell over kostnader'
tuition.notes: Quote is a table row; column headers on same page: 'Årlig pris 2026/2027 (NOK) Årlig pris 2027/2028 (NOK)'. 2026/27 was NOK 182 000. Fees adjusted annually; exact fee stated in the offer.

scholarship_exists.quote: Scholarships : The University of Oslo does not offer any scholarships for students on full bachelor's and master's degree programmes.
scholarship_exists.how_found: UiO English admission index page; confirmed on tuition page
scholarship_exists.notes: Also on https://www.uio.no/english/studies/admission/tuition/index.html: 'UiO does not offer any scholarships that cover tuition fees. The university is legally barred from using our grant for student scholarships.'

scholarship_international.quote: UiO does not offer any scholarships that cover tuition fees. The university is legally barred from using our grant for student scholarships.
scholarship_international.notes: No university-run scholarship exists, so the international-eligibility question does not apply (effectively false for this applicant).

access_notes: All uio.no pages fetched as static HTML (no JS/blocks). URLs https://www.uio.no/english/studies/admission/bachelor/, .../tuition-fees/ and /studier/opptak/generell-studiekompetanse/ returned 404 (guessed paths). Exact Norwegian/English test levels and Kazakhstan diploma recognition are on samordnaopptak.no/hkdir.no, not opened (non-university domains).
